title: 第18章 风城往事十八第19章 风城往事终
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
苏家。
“柳妈，东西都准备好了吗。”苏鸿成道。
“老爷，随行的下人们都穿戴好了，随时可以出发。”柳妈回道。
“哎，苏天那个混小子呢？”
“这……不知道”
“这个混小子，一天到晚不着家，算了，这种场合他还是少去吧。”苏鸿成起身带着众人向刘家走去。
角落中，苏天走了出来，身后还带着尹三尹四。
“呵，好戏开场了。”
城南。
苏鸿章今早便去给刘刘纪吊唁，只剩何倩几人在屋中。
苏少卿这十几天终于是将伤势稳定了下来，不过还是不能动，一直在床上躺着。
何倩在家中忙前忙后收拾着一切，李鹏则是关注着房子四周，时刻警惕着。
然而，还是有三个黑衣人不请自来，缓缓的向着这间房子走了过来。
“三位，还请离开这里。”李鹏站在三人面前。
“老先生，我们来这儿是来探亲戚的。”领头的黑衣人道。
“探亲戚，这里只有一户人家，我看你们是走错了吧。”李鹏道。
“没走错，我们来看的就是那一户人家。”领头道笑了笑，：“动手。”
不等李鹏反应，身后的俩个黑衣人便瞬间来到李鹏身旁，一拳将李鹏打飞。
砰！
小院的大门被倒飞的李鹏撞开，何倩听见声响，急忙出来查看，一开门便看见李鹏倒在地上，嘴边还有鲜血流出。

“李叔，你怎么了。”
“少夫人，快跑！”李鹏喊道。
“哼哼，想跑，你往那跑。”尹三一脚踩在李鹏胸上，让他动弹不得。
“无量三段，也敢在爷爷面前造次，也不掂量掂量自己的那点份量。”尹三道。
“你们是谁，来这干什么！”何倩急道。
“伯母，不用紧张，我只是来看望一下你们，毕竟你们如今的生活是我爹一手造成的，我理应替我爹赔罪。”苏天摘下帽子走了进来。
“苏天，这里不欢迎你，还请离开。”何倩别过头道：“还有，告诉苏鸿成，他既然做了，就不用假惺惺的过来道歉，从今往后，我们与苏家井水不犯河水，不再有任何往来。”
“伯母，你认为去爹会让我来吗。”苏天笑道：“今天我来，是为了送您一份大礼。”
“苏天，你要杀就杀我，别动少夫人。”李鹏喊道。
苏天给尹三了一个眼神，尹三会意，提起李鹏，一脚踹了上去，李鹏登时便飞了出去，撞在墙上昏了过去。
“李叔！”何倩想要跑过去却被尹三尹四二人架住双手，动弹不得。
“苏天，你到底要干什么！”何倩怒道。
“伯母，我说了，我就是来送你一个大礼而已。”苏天道。
何倩愤怒的看着苏天。
“我们的苏大天才就在这里吧。”苏天笑推开门。
content_en:
Su family.
"Liu Ma, are everything ready?" Su Hongcheng said.
"Master, the accompanying servants are all dressed and ready to go at any time." Liu Ma replied.
"Hey, where is that bastard Su Tian?"
"I don't know..."
"This bastard never stays home all day long. Forget it, he should go less often to such occasions." Su Hongcheng stood up and led everyone towards Liu's house.
In the corner, Su Tian walked out, followed by Yin San and Yin Si.
"Heh, the show is about to begin."
South of the city.
Su Hongzhang went to express condolences to Liu Liuji this morning, leaving only He Qian and others in the house.
Su Shaoqing finally stabilized his injury in the past ten days, but he still couldn't move and kept lying on the bed.
He Qian was busy at home tidying up everything, while Li Peng was paying attention to the surroundings of the house, always vigilant.
However, there were still three men in black who came uninvited and slowly walked towards the house.
"You three, please leave here." Li Peng stood in front of the three of them.
"Old sir, we are here to visit relatives." The leading man in black said.
"Visiting relatives, there is only one family here. I think you went to the wrong place." Li Peng said.
"You're right, that's the house we came to see." The leader smiled and said, "Do it."
Before Li Peng could react, the two men in black immediately came to Li Peng's side and punched him away.
Bang!
The door of the small courtyard was knocked open by Li Peng who was flying upside down. He Qian heard the noise and hurriedly came out to check. As soon as she opened the door, she saw Li Peng lying on the ground with blood flowing out of his mouth.
"Uncle Li, what's wrong with you?"
"Young madam, run!" Li Peng shouted.
"Hmph, if you want to run, go over there." Yin San stepped on Li Peng's chest, making him unable to move.
"Wuliang Sandan, you dare to make a mistake in front of grandpa, and you don't even think about your own weight." Yin San said.
"Who are you and what are you doing here!" He Qian asked anxiously.
"Aunt, don't be nervous. I'm just here to visit you. After all, my father is responsible for your current life. I should apologize for my father." Su Tian took off his hat and walked in.
"Su Tian, you are not welcome here, please leave." He Qian turned her head and said, "Also, tell Su Hongcheng that since he did it, there is no need to come here to apologize hypocritically. From now on, we will not be in conflict with the Su family and we will no longer have any contact with each other."
"Auntie, do you think my father will let me come?" Su Tian smiled and said, "I am here today to give you a big gift."
"Su Tian, if you want to kill me, kill me, don't touch the young lady." Li Peng shouted.
Su Tian gave Yin San a look. Yin San understood, picked up Li Peng and kicked him up. Li Peng immediately flew out, hit the wall and passed out.
"Uncle Li!" He Qian wanted to run over, but Yin San and Yin Si held her hands, unable to move.
"Su Tian, ​​what on earth are you going to do!" He Qian said angrily.
"Auntie, I told you, I'm just here to give you a big gift." Su Tiandao.
He Qian looked at Su Tian angrily.
"Our genius Su is right here." Su Tianxiao opened the door.
